laat_vaar.voor: kry water uit damme vir huise en nywerhede
laat_vaar.na: kry water vir huise en nywerhede uit damme
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: As written, 'damme vir huise en nywerhede' can be read as dams meant for houses and industries; putting the purpose first removes that misreading.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original is natural Afrikaans and the 'dams for houses' reading would not mislead, since dams do serve houses and industries; the reorder is a lateral move that also breaks the parallel 'water uit damme' in the next sentence.

vlae.teks: Die Oranjerivier (Gariep) met die Gariepdam op die rivier
vlae.rede: The protected entry says the bracketed 'Gariep' stands once, at the first mention, and must not be repeated. It already appears in the study block 'Die Gariepdam', and the map block repeats it. I did not change it because it is protected wording; a person or the writer should decide whether the map description counts as a second mention.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: om te swem, te visvang en te ontspan
laat_vaar_vorige.na: om te swem, vis te vang en te ontspan
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'vis te vang' is the natural infinitive; 'te visvang' sounds forced.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'te visvang' is correct Afrikaans with 'visvang' as a verb, so the proposal is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The separable particle 'op' belongs at the end of the clause; placing the adjunct after it is a spoken-style construction.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Placing a prepositional phrase after the separable particle is normal written Afrikaans, and ending on 'met turbines' reads naturally, so the reorder is a lateral move.
